title: Choosing devices for a school network
body:
Ms. Rao is setting up the network of her school. The computer laboratory has 30 PCs that must be joined into a LAN. She lists three requirements:
(i) Inside the laboratory, a packet sent by one PC should be delivered only to the PC it is meant for, so that the network is not flooded and packets from different PCs do not collide.
(ii) The school's LAN must be connected to the Internet through the broadband line provided by the school's Internet Service Provider, and all data going out of or coming into the school network must pass through one access point.
(iii) A firewall should check the traffic at the point where the school network meets the Internet.
The devices available to her are a hub, a switch, a repeater, a modem and a router.
